items.title: Nintendo's legendary Kirby designer Masahiro Sakurai weighs in on gen-AI, saying "it has yet to gain my trust" but not to reject it completely
items.excerpt: At a Famitsu 40th-anniversary stage event, Super Smash Bros. creator Masahiro Sakurai said he does not use generative AI and it has yet to earn his trust, but warned that refusing it outright could leave developers behind in an over-demanding industry.

items.title: Super Smash Bros. Creator Masahiro Sakurai Cautions Against The Use Of Gen AI: 'We Can Come Up With Better Ideas'
items.excerpt: Sakurai says generative AI is not ready for adoption in his work and must not become exploitation, but fears developers may have no choice but to use it on future games. (Same story as the Eurogamer item - alternate source.)

items.title: Google AI developer's unauthorized iPhone Duo port of the Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake, made with Gemini 4, draws backlash and is deleted
items.excerpt: Google employee Ammaar Reshi posted on 11-07 that he had used Gemini 4 to get Nintendo's full Ocarina of Time remake running on iPhone Duo; the post drew criticism over engineering ethics and IP and has since been deleted.

items.title: 구글 AI 총괄, 젤다 신작 아이폰에 '무단 이식'...뭇매에 삭제
items.excerpt: Korean coverage of the Google AI lead who used Google's AI coding tools to port Nintendo's new Ocarina of Time remake to iPhone without permission, then deleted the post after backlash. (Same story as AUTOMATON - alternate source.)

items.title: 完全オフライン、無制限、53言語対応。「日本発の翻訳AI」無償公開から数日、ゲーマー向けツールも続々登場
items.excerpt: Days after Preferred Networks released its free, fully offline translation model PLaMo 3 Translate (53 languages, no usage limits), developers are releasing gamer-facing translation tools built on it.

items.title: NVIDIA's Lyra 2.0 Turns a Single Image Into an Explorable 3D World, With Persistent Environments and Real-Time Rendering
items.excerpt: NVIDIA's Lyra 2.0 generates an explorable, persistent 3D world from a single image by combining AI video generation, spatial memory and 3D reconstruction, rendered in real time - a new world-model version aimed at environment creation.

items.title: AMDLSS5 2.0 Brings Faster DLSS 5 Neural Rendering to Radeon GPUs, Claims 64% Higher FPS
items.excerpt: A community mod, AMDLSS5 2.0, ports NVIDIA's DLSS 5 neural-rendering pass to AMD Radeon GPUs, claiming 64% higher FPS than competing mods and adding support for more games.

items.title: Jackbox Games isn't interested in AI development: 'All that is done by people, and we have no intention of changing that'
items.excerpt: Jackbox CEO Mike Bilder says the studio's comedy, writing and art will stay human-made and it has no intention of replacing people or people-made editorial and art with generative assets, while allowing AI's use for tooling and research.

items.title: 최석원 컴투스플랫폼 대표 "'하이브 액실'로 글로벌 공략⋯백엔드 연동 AI로 처리"
items.excerpt: Com2uS Platform says its game backend Hive Axel is built so AI agents can read it and wire up login, payments and other backend integration with almost no human intervention; Unreal, Godot and HTML5 support follows in early 2027.

items.title: 스팀 리뷰 1,900만 건 분석, 게임 속 AI 긍정 평가 요인은?
items.excerpt: Nexon's AI division analysed about 19.37 million Steam user reviews to find when players accept AI inside games, winning a best-paper award at IEEE ICTAI 2026; Nexon is building a pre-launch check of player reaction to in-game AI features.

items.title: AI에 게임 도둑 맞았습니다
items.excerpt: As coding AI makes cloning indie games trivial, solo-developed Slotbound was copied as a mini-game on a large Chinese platform before launch; the developer describes the takedown struggle across overseas platforms.

items.title: Artists at the center: How InnoGames integrated gen AI into its art pipeline
items.excerpt: In a guest article, InnoGames head of art Dario Berruti explains how the studio integrated generative AI into its game-art production workflows while keeping artists at the center. (Off-list source: design-relevant art-pipeline story not found on allowed outlets.)

items.title: Petit Planet devs talk multiplayer, monetization, AI, and... Clarkson's Farm?
items.excerpt: HoYoverse's Petit Planet leads discuss the game's AI NPC system, which remembers each player's conversation history to give personalised interactions, ahead of its 12-04 global launch. (Off-list source: allowed-outlet previews omit the AI NPC detail.)

items.title: コード非公開のWebサイト・アプリ・ゲームを解析し、AIが類似版を生成する無料ツール「Craft Anything」
items.excerpt: Open-source tool Craft Anything analyses closed-source websites, apps and games and uses AI to generate a working look-alike, including a mode that reads internal code - sharpening the AI game-clone debate. (Off-list source.)

items.title: GamesBeat Next: Rod Humble and Luke Dicken size up AI's real impact on game development
items.excerpt: Megastructure CEO Rod Humble and former Take-Two head of AI Luke Dicken agreed on more than expected about AI in game development but split on how fast developers should adopt new tools.
